title: Farm practices
description: Cut emissions at their source on the farm. Several practices on the same source combine: each acts on what the others leave.

feedAdditives.title: Feed additives
feedAdditives.description: Additives such as 3-NOP that cut the methane cattle belch, where animals are fed.

breedingAndFeed.title: Breeding and better feed
breedingAndFeed.description: Animals bred and fed to belch less methane per litre or kilo.

manureManagement.title: Manure management
manureManagement.description: Covered stores, digesters and faster removal cut methane and nitrous oxide from manure.

riceWater.title: Rice paddies drained
riceWater.description: Draining paddies once or more in the season cuts their methane.

nitrogenEfficiency.title: Less nitrogen, better used
nitrogenEfficiency.description: Fertiliser matched to the crop's needs, so less of it turns into nitrous oxide.

nitrificationInhibitors.title: Nitrification inhibitors
nitrificationInhibitors.description: Products added to fertiliser that slow its turning into nitrous oxide.

farmEnergy.title: Clean farm energy
farmEnergy.description: Machinery, pumps and heating run without fossil fuel. Acts in the cradle-to-farm-gate scope only; cleaner electricity is Renewable electricity's.
